correctness.rationale: Appending a binary zero preserves adjacent-11 parity, and appending one toggles it iff the parent index is odd. Applying the resulting pair rule three times yields the four aligned 8-blocks; independent enumeration confirmed 56 distinct 8-windows with disjoint start phases and 104 possible length-14 windows across parity-alternating block triples, each present at least six times in the first 1024 bits. Any shorter factor can be extended to the right in the infinite word, including at a finite prefix boundary, giving enough embedded repetitions. For length k≥15 the child start parity is recognized by the first eight symbols, and its residue mod 8 also gives the first parent index parity needed to decode a partial pair. The touched parent factor has length ceil(k/2) for even starts and floor(k/2)+1 for odd starts, both at least eight. All copies of a parent factor therefore have the same parent start parity, and each yields a matching child occurrence, fitting inside the finite prefix even when an endpoint pair is only partially used. This is a bijection, not just an inequality of multiplicities. An independent suffix-neighbor longest-common-prefix scan gives minimum 18 and starts 175,191,207,223,367,383,399,415 at n=9; n=10–12 give 34,66,130 with the stated starts. Below 2ℓ_n−2 both parent lengths are less than ℓ_n; at equality, only odd starts can come from a parent singleton of length ℓ_n, and each such start lifts by p↦2p+1. The finite certificates plus this induction prove the length and complete eight-start classification for all n≥9.
residual_risks: Both exact scans and phase/saturation certificates concern bounded finite tasks; the occurrence transport and induction establish the unbounded conclusion. No assertion is made for smaller orders, other prefix lengths or all longer minimal unique factors.

value.rationale: The first factor length that distinguishes even one position of an explicitly structured finite word is a natural substring invariant. Here the exact scale, bounded number eight, and locations give a complete benchmark for shortest-unique-factor procedures on an infinite family. The synchronization argument explains the stable positional pattern rather than merely listing individual computations.
residual_risks: This does not classify all unique factors or give data for arbitrary prefix lengths.
